messages.subject: adding record with no observation
parts:

I am trying to add a record with no observations (where the ID field is
blank). But, Distance states the cell must contain a value. How can I
add a record with no observation?

messages.author: 12f269733c6eb9a2
messages.subject: Re: adding record with no observation
parts:
Scott:

This arises in a situation where you exerted effort on a transect (or at
a point) but detected no animals, correct? Under these circumstances,
you need to acknowledge that you expended effort, but had no successful
detections. In Chapter 5 of the users guide, you will read about
importing data into Distance. A few pages in to that discussion, there
is an example of a text file that has been prepared for import. It
shows a record (associated with Line1 in stratum B) whereon no animals
were detected. The other information about the line must be included.
This is how you would create your files for import.

If you open the "Stratify example.dst" in the sample projects directory,
you will see another example of transects where there were no detections
(for example lines 5 and 6 of habitat type 1).
